defect.problem: The citation set carries both '96 L. Ed. 2d 183' and '96 L. Ed. 183' — identical volume 96 and identical page 183 but two different Lawyers' Edition series. A single case cannot appear at the same volume/page in both L. Ed. and L. Ed. 2d; one entry is a duplicate/data-entry error. The disclosed date_decided 1952-01-02 is consistent with the first-series form '96 L. Ed. 183', making '96 L. Ed. 2d 183' the spurious entry.
defect.proposed_fix: Drop the erroneous '96 L. Ed. 2d 183' parallel and retain '96 L. Ed. 183' (correct first-series L. Ed. cite for the 1952 decision).
